data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata, bounded public DOM evidence, necessary short source excerpts, and short generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Public visibility and downloadability do not establish redistribution rights.

collection_context.session_checked_at_note: Initial navigation was after the scheduled time. Discovery had no login overlay and an account-menu control was present. Only its presence, not identity or contents, was retained.
collection_context.login_reason: Existing cloud-browser session already exposed requested public discovery and detail metadata.
collection_context.completion_note: Both requested ten-card sections, five unique detail inspections, and twenty fresh URL-specific cover downloads completed. Downloaded content deduplicated to thirteen files. Runtime unavailable; no gameplay attempted.

scope.sampling_rule: First 10 game-card containers in this section rendered DOM order; non-game creation promotion omitted. Nested action nodes are not counted as games.

source_extensions.detail_selection_rule: First five unique games in Trending-then-Popular order; five total across the file. All five also occur in Popular. Details stored once independently.

limitations: Bounded, non-random sample of rendered game-card DOM order, not an official numeric ranking or a platform-wide popularity census.
Existing authenticated cloud-browser session was usable. No sign-in, permission, profile, voting, following, or gameplay action was performed. Account identity and private areas are excluded.
Trending refers to player growth over 24 hours, but no numeric growth value was supplied. Displayed plays and likes are not growth measures.
Popular selected tab was 高人气游戏, aria-selected=true, panel aria-hidden=false, with subtitle In the last 7 days. This does not explicitly define each card metric accumulation window.
The two sections were read independently. Repeated games retain independent links, card metrics, section evidence, and image-source observations. Their counts must not be added across sections.
All 20 observed image URLs were separately downloaded. Content hashes deduplicated the resulting bytes to 13 covers. No historical cover bytes were reused.
Five details exposed public metadata but displayed a browser-component error for running the game. No gameplay was attempted. Collapsed description remainder was not read.
No previous metric values or descriptions were carried forward. Page descriptions are source claims, not verified gameplay experience.
